constraints.name: mop_backup_run_event_action_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((action)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['QUEUE'::character varying, 'START'::character varying, 'MARK_UNKNOWN'::character varying, 'SUCCEED'::character varying, 'FAIL'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: mop_backup_run_event_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((queued_at >= '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (queued_at <= observed_at) AND (observed_at <= '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999+00'::timestamp with time zone)))

constraints.name: mop_backup_run_event_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((action)::text = 'QUEUE'::text) AND ((state)::text = 'QUEUED'::text) AND (version = 0) AND (attempt_number = 0) AND (queued_at = observed_at)) OR (((action)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['START'::character varying, 'MARK_UNKNOWN'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((state)::text = 'RUNNING'::text) AND (version >= 1) AND ((attempt_number >= 1) AND (attempt_number <= 3))) OR (((action)::text = 'SUCCEED'::text) AND ((state)::text = 'SUCCEEDED'::text) AND (version >= 2) AND ((attempt_number >= 1) AND (attempt_number <= 3))) OR (((action)::text = 'FAIL'::text) AND (version >= 2) AND ((((state)::text = 'RETRY_WAIT'::text) AND ((attempt_number >= 1) AND (attempt_number <= 2))) OR (((state)::text = 'FAILED'::text) AND (attempt_number = 3))))))

constraints.name: mop_backup_run_event_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((action)::text = 'QUEUE'::text) AND (lease_request_id IS NULL) AND (lease_event_version IS NULL) AND (lease_owner IS NULL) AND (fencing_token IS NULL)) OR (((action)::text <> 'QUEUE'::text) AND (lease_request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_event_version IS NOT NULL) AND ((lease_event_version >= 1) AND (lease_event_version <= '9007199254740991'::bigint)) AND (lease_owner IS NOT NULL) AND (length((lease_owner)::text) > 0) AND ((lease_owner)::text !~ '[^A-Za-z0-9._:-]'::text) AND (fencing_token IS NOT NULL) AND ((fencing_token >= 1) AND (fencing_token <= '9007199254740991'::bigint)))))

constraints.name: mop_backup_run_event_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((action)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SUCCEED'::character varying, 'FAIL'::character varying])::text[])) AND (verification_reference IS NOT NULL) AND ((verification_reference)::text ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) OR (((action)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['SUCCEED'::character varying, 'FAIL'::character varying])::text[])) AND (verification_reference IS NULL))))

constraints.name: mop_backup_run_event_check6
constraints.definition: CHECK (((SUBSTRING(snapshot FROM 1 FOR 28) = decode('001a4d4f505f4241434b55505f52554e5f534e415053484f545f5631'::text, 'hex'::text)) AND (SUBSTRING(snapshot FROM 29 FOR 38) = (decode('0024'::text, 'hex'::text) || convert_to((run_id)::text, 'UTF8'::name))) AND (SUBSTRING(snapshot FROM 67 FOR 38) = (decode('0024'::text, 'hex'::text) || convert_to((tenant_id)::text, 'UTF8'::name))) AND (SUBSTRING(snapshot FROM 105 FOR 38) = (decode('0024'::text, 'hex'::text) || convert_to((asset_id)::text, 'UTF8'::name))) AND (SUBSTRING(snapshot FROM 143 FOR 8) = int8send(((EXTRACT(epoch FROM queued_at) * (1000)::numeric))::bigint)) AND (SUBSTRING(snapshot FROM 151 FOR 8) = int8send(version)) AND (SUBSTRING(snapshot FROM 159 FOR 4) = int4send(attempt_number))))

constraints.name: mop_backup_run_event_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['QUEUED'::character varying, 'RUNNING'::character varying, 'RETRY_WAIT'::character varying, 'SUCCEEDED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying])::text[])))
